requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: Art. 47 c. 3 and 5: an increment is paid from the first day of the month in which the biennium is completed when more than 15 days of that month remain, and on a promotion 'il dipendente mantiene l'importo in cifra fissa degli aumenti maturati nel livello di provenienza'. The engine pays from the month after the biennium and prices all the increments at the current level.
requirements.remediation: Bring the increment forward when more than 15 days of the month remain, and keep the matured increments at the amounts of the level they matured in.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: The two una tantum installments are paid, but the agreement counts months of effective work; the engine counts months of employment, without reducing for months with no effective work. An absence spanning a covered month can overstate the payment.
requirements.remediation: Provide the covered months of effective work for this payment and count only those months when prorating each installment.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
